## Motivation

Register the existing manual NIXL EP test under `test/registered/ep/test_deepep_large.py` so CI can exercise NIXL EP coverage through the standard registered test rerun workflow. The NIXL 1.3.0 package is incompatible with the CI image's Torch 2.14 ABI, so the installer must select a NIXL release that provides the Torch-versioned extension.

## Modifications

- Install `nixl>=1.5.0` and the CUDA 13 binary package with `--no-deps`.
- Add the manual NIXL EP wrapper to `test/registered/ep/test_deepep_large.py`.
- Skip the existing DeepEP large tests in CI while retaining their local manual behavior.
- Keep the Elastic EP scale wrapper registered but skipped until its runtime path is ready for CI.
- Remove the temporary Mooncake PR #5063 wheel override used by the earlier validation-only branch.

## Accuracy Tests

Not run locally in this source-only registration change. The registered NIXL test provides the CI accuracy gate.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
🚀 `8-gpu-h200` (1 test): ❌ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41771431821) <!--rrt:0:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/ep/test_deepep_large.py
```

🚀 `8-gpu-h200` (1 test): ❌ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41772487725) <!--rrt:0:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/ep/test_deepep_large.py
```

The isolated NIXL rerun (run 41772487725) still fails with `elastic_ep_backend=None` confirmed in server args. NIXL EP initializes on all 8 ranks, but startup hits scheduler/tokenizer watchdog timeouts and GSM8K is severely corrupted (`score=0.005`, `truncated=66.5%`, `invalid=52.5%`). This rules out the Mooncake Elastic EP parameter and points to the NIXL EP/CI communication or initialization path.

@@ -830,18 +829,9 @@ install_extra_deps() {
 
     $PIP_CMD install "helion==1.4.0" $PIP_INSTALL_SUFFIX
 
-    NIXL_INSTALLED=$(pip show nixl 2>/dev/null | grep "^Version:" | awk '{print $2}' || echo "")
-    NIXL_BIN_INSTALLED=$(pip show "${NIXL_BIN_NAME}" 2>/dev/null | grep "^Version:" | awk '{print $2}' || echo "")
-    if [ "$NIXL_INSTALLED" = "$NIXL_VERSION" ] && [ "$NIXL_BIN_INSTALLED" = "$NIXL_VERSION" ]; then
-        echo "nixl==${NIXL_VERSION} and ${NIXL_BIN_NAME}==${NIXL_VERSION} already installed, keeping them"
-    else
-        echo "nixl mismatch (meta: ${NIXL_INSTALLED:-none}, ${NIXL_BIN_NAME}: ${NIXL_BIN_INSTALLED:-none}, required: ${NIXL_VERSION}); installing"
-        # Meta stub owns the nixl import path; install only the CUDA binary for
-        # this runner's torch CUDA major. --no-deps avoids pulling the other CUDA
-        # variant; leave any other variant already on the runner image untouched.
-        $PIP_CMD install "nixl==${NIXL_VERSION}" "${NIXL_BIN_NAME}==${NIXL_VERSION}" \
-            --no-deps --force-reinstall $PIP_INSTALL_SUFFIX
-    fi
